name: sitebulb-cloud
description: Technical SEO skills and read-only access to your Sitebulb Cloud audits: audit summaries, hints and insights, URL-level data, change-over-time comparisons, prioritised fixes, client audit documents and dev tickets.

interface.shortDescription: Technical-SEO skills powered by your Sitebulb Cloud audits
interface.longDescription: Five technical-SEO skills that work with your Sitebulb Cloud audits: prioritise fixes, track changes between crawls, produce client-facing audit documents, raise dev tickets, and run post-release checks. The plugin connects to Sitebulb Cloud through its MCP server, with OAuth sign-in to your Sitebulb account. For Sitebulb Desktop audits, install the Sitebulb Desktop plugin.
defaultPrompt: What should I fix first on this site?
